caption: The image is of an embroidered sampler on a rectangular piece of beige cloth, bordered by a wide decorative frame of blue-green and white flowers with green leaves, forming a continuous pattern around the edges. Inside the border, the main area contains several rows of alphabet letters in both uppercase and lowercase, as well as numerals, rendered in black and brown thread using various styles of stitching. Below the alphabets and numbers, there is a short verse stitched in black that reads: "Within my breast may peace & dwelling find May my good will extend to all mankind." Beneath this verse, the name "Marcia Bryant" and the date "1821/1822" are prominently embroidered in large black letters and numbers. The bottom section features a floral motif with green stems and leaves, and light blue and white flowers, similar to the border design. All the stitching is carefully aligned and symmetrical, and the background of the sampler remains the natural linen color.
title: Sampler
